headline: 14 buses launched: Women-only 'Pink Bus' service begins in Dhaka and other cities
summary: The BRTC has introduced a dedicated bus service for women to ensure safer and more comfortable public transport across several major cities.
details: A women-only bus service, branded as the "Pink Bus," was launched today to provide safer and more comfortable public transport for women. Road Transport and Bridges, Railway and Shipping Minister Shaikh Rabiul Alam inaugurated the service at the BRTC Tejgaon Bus Depot.
caption:
Safer commutes for women! 🚌💖 The BRTC has launched a dedicated 'Pink Bus' service across multiple cities.

A women-only bus service, branded as the "Pink Bus," was launched today to provide safer and more comfortable public transport for women. Road Transport and Bridges, Railway and Shipping Minister Shaikh Rabiul Alam inaugurated the service at the BRTC Tejgaon Bus Depot.

headline: Trump approval rating falls to 33%, lowest of his presidency
summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll shows a sharp decline in popularity due to the U.S. war with Iran and rising gasoline prices affecting U.S. households.
details: President Donald Trump's approval rating has dropped to 33%, the lowest point of his presidency, according to a new Reuters/Ipsos poll. Approximately 64% of respondents disapproved of his performance in the White House.

The decline is largely attributed to the U.S. war with Iran, which began after Trump ordered strikes on Iran alongside Israel. The conflict has paralyzed a fifth of the global oil trade, causing gasoline prices to surge.
About 80% of Americans believe the involvement in Iran will last for an extended period, contradicting Trump's initial claims that the conflict would be a short-term engagement.
Only one in five Americans, and just half of Republicans, believe the war has been worth the cost. Trump has defended the action as necessary to prevent Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons.
The economic impact is causing concern among Republicans, as voters now prefer Democrats as better stewards of the economy for the first time in a decade.
Republican support for immigration policy has also seen a sharp decline, with the gap between Republican and 2-point spread between Republicans and Democrats now the lowest of Trump's term.
The online poll of 1,166 U.S. adults nationwide had a margin of error of 3 percentage points.
caption:
Trump's approval rating has plummeted to 33%—the lowest of his presidency. Is the war with Iran costing him his popularity?

President Donald Trump's approval rating has dropped to 33%, the lowest point of his presidency, according to a new Reuters/Ipsos poll. Approximately 64% of respondents disapproved of his performance in the White House.

The decline is largely attributed to the U.S. war with Iran, which began after Trump ordered strikes on Iran alongside Israel. The conflict has paralyzed a fifth of the global oil trade, causing gasoline prices to surge.

About 80% of Americans believe the involvement in Iran will last for an extended period, contradicting Trump's initial claims that the conflict would be a short-term engagement.

Only one in five Americans, and just half of Republicans, believe the war has been worth the cost. Trump has defended the action as necessary to prevent Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons.

The economic impact is causing concern among Republicans, as voters now prefer Democrats as better stewards of the economy for the first time in a decade.

Republican support for immigration policy has also seen a sharp decline, with the gap between Republican and 2-point spread between Republicans and Democrats now the lowest of Trump's term.

The online poll of 1,166 U.S. adults nationwide had a margin of error of 3 percentage points.
